entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: An angelic avenger, created from Ixidor's imagination, who wages war against Phage.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: A reality sculptor exiled by reality, whose imagination shapes Akroma and a dream chisel.

entities.name: Phage the Untouchable
entities.description: A being of the Cabal who drains energy from victims; once the warrior Jeska.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A warrior whose memory stirs in Phage.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A former pit fighter turned druid acolyte of Krosa who believes in the power of muscle.

entities.name: Commander Eesha
entities.description: An aven commander who helps the Southern Order and laments the Cabal's influence.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: The leader of the Cabal.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A Cabal dementia summoner.

entities.name: Matoc
entities.description: A lavamancer.

entities.name: Toggo
entities.description: A goblin weaponsmith who loves lightning.

entities.name: Furt
entities.description: A goblin who discovered strange creatures were not like bugs.

entities.name: Zemoo
entities.description: A goblin who found that inflammable and flammable mean the same thing.

entities.name: Darius
entities.description: A character warned about a goblin sneaking up.

entities.name: Jareth
entities.description: Light's champion in the stronghold of darkness.

entities.name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
entities.description: A wizard who journeyed where none have been before and returns to stop others.

entities.name: Silvos
entities.description: An elemental born of the Mirari, thrust from his homeland, who found purpose in the pits.

entities.name: Rorix Bladewing
entities.description: A dragon of Shiv seeking to restore the race's pride.

entities.name: Visara the Dreadful
entities.description: A being whose eyes are her strongest feature.

entities.name: Ancestor
entities.description: The deity of the nomads and aven.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact whose energy the Order clerics contain; its call transformed the Krosan Forest.

entities.name: Dream Chisel
entities.description: A chisel born of Ixidor's psyche that brings his darkest dreams to life.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A death-worshipping order that runs the Coliseum pits.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A group of clerics and fighters opposing the Cabal.

entities.name: Riptide Project
entities.description: A school of wizards devoted to preventing the spread of knowledge.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The land in danger of demise.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: A city with swamps alive with the dead.

entities.name: Krosan Forest
entities.description: A forest transformed by the Mirari.

entities.name: Wirewood
entities.description: The forest where elven refugees settled.

entities.name: Skirk Ridge
entities.description: A ridge overrun by goblins.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A land left in smoldering ashes.

entities.name: Daru Plains
entities.description: Plains of tall grass.

entities.name: Grand Coliseum
entities.description: The site of the Cabal's pit fights.

events.summary: Akroma, created by Ixidor's imagination, treats clerics as allies in her war against Phage.
events.quote: She saw them only as allies in her war against Phage.

events.summary: Ixidor imagines the ruin of enemies and Akroma makes it so.
events.quote: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

events.summary: Akroma vows to stay her hand only when Phage is destroyed.
events.quote: Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand.

events.summary: Phage drains her victims' energy and a faint memory of Jeska stirs before she is lost again.
events.quote: As Phage drank their energy, a vague memory of Jeska stirred.

events.summary: Phage became both executioner and savior, helping others to the rebirth she found.
events.quote: Phage became both executioner and savior, helping others to the same rebirth she had found.

events.summary: Ixidor declares reality has exiled him.
events.quote: Reality has exiled me. I am no longer bound by its laws.

events.summary: Silvos is born of the Mirari and thrust out of his homeland, finding purpose in the pits.
events.quote: He was born of the Mirari, thrust out of his homeland before he was even aware.

events.summary: The Mirari calls to the centaurs, changing all who heard it.
events.quote: The Mirari called to the centaurs, and all who heard it were forever changed.

events.summary: Kamahl leaves his violent former life behind.
events.quote: Kamahl left the violence of his former life behind him

events.summary: Krosa unleashes peace in Kamahl and Kamahl unleashes fury in Krosa.
events.quote: As Krosa unleashed the peace in Kamahl, he unleashed the fury in Krosa.

events.summary: Order clerics contain the Mirari's energy to delay Otaria's demise.
events.quote: Every day, Order clerics contain as much of the Mirari's energy as possible, hoping to delay Otaria's demise.

events.summary: Pacified by Akroma, even born warriors lay down their blades at her feet.
events.quote: Even those born to battle could only lay their blades at Akroma's feet.

events.summary: Furt the goblin discovers the strange creatures were not like bugs.
events.quote: To his surprise, Furt discovered that the strange creatures were not at all like bugs.

events.summary: Goblins move into Skirk Ridge and lay it waste.
Rorix Bladewing and other dragons strive to rebuild Shiv.
events.quote: In the smoldering ashes of Shiv, a few dragons strive to rebuild their native land.
Maybe they wanted to be on the winning side for once.

relations.note: Akroma made real what Ixidor imagined
relations.quote: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.
She saw them only as allies in her war against Phage.
